# Shards of the tests of ./cmd in the CI (job "Go CLI tests").
#
# Written by .github/scripts/test-shards.sh (balance, sync): do not edit by hand.
# A new test or package is in no shard until `test-shards.sh sync` (run from cli/)
# puts it in the lightest one: the check of the CI fails until then.
# The shards were balanced on the durations of one run; `balance <json>` does it
# again from a `go test ./... -json` run.
#
# shards: 4
# Format: name shard (1 to 4) seconds
